body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2009') -- <Visual News> Toshiba's mobile LED projector 'TDP-F10' was displayed at the TI booth during CES 2009, which weighs just over a pound and comparable to the size of a paperback nove.
